entries.title: Elder Tree Grove
entries.summary: Defend the ancient forest in one wave and collect Spirit Cores.
entries.rules: Face the Awakened Elder Tree and its reinforcements. Keep your team alive through sweeping slams.

entries.title: Crystal Mine
entries.summary: Explore the mines and break crystal shields to gather Crystals.
entries.rules: Planned: a golem protects its crystal core; break its shield to create a damage window.

entries.title: Ancient Forge
entries.summary: Venture into the lost forge to find equipment development materials.
entries.rules: Planned: mechanical guards defend forging stations; defeat the blacksmith boss at the corridor's end.

entries.title: Spirit Sanctuary
entries.summary: Protect the spirits through waves of attacks in the sanctuary.
entries.rules: Planned: protect a spirit through multiple waves. Combine healing, shields, and crowd control.

entries.title: Pirate Treasure
entries.summary: Defeat the captain and discover treasure by the shipwreck.
entries.rules: Planned: defeat the captain before time runs out to unlock the pirate treasure.

entries.title: Six-Wave Tower
entries.summary: Carry HP and Energy through six waves to reach the final floor.
entries.rules: Carry your team through six waves; time your skills and preserve allies for the final boss.

entries.title: Mist Labyrinth
entries.summary: Choose your path and powers wisely through the mist.
entries.rules: Planned: choose one of two effects per floor to strengthen your team or alter the challenge.

entries.title: Elemental Arena
entries.summary: Adjust your team to overcome elemental resistance.
entries.rules: Planned: enemies have distinct elemental resistances; choose heroes and spirits for each wave.

entries.title: Hall of Mirrors
entries.summary: Find the true target among mirror copies.
entries.rules: Planned: an enemy creates weaker copies; identify and focus on the real target.

entries.title: Ruins of Time
entries.summary: Adapt to shifting phases of time.
entries.rules: Planned: skill cooldowns and attack speed change with the ruins' temporal phases.

entries.title: Dawn Triad
entries.summary: Face three consecutive bosses guarding the path to dawn.
entries.rules: Three existing boss waves: Awakened Elder Tree, Ember Guardian, and Tidal Mirage. Prepare your skills for each mechanic.

entries.title: Ancient Dragon Cave
entries.summary: Face the Infernal Dragon in its lava cave.
entries.rules: Planned: a multi-phase boss with burns and area attacks; gather high-tier forging materials.

entries.title: Void Abyss
entries.summary: Enter the rift where the Light Devourer awaits.
entries.rules: Planned: the boss summons shadows and shields itself; balance clearing minions with breaking shields.

entries.title: Eclipse Palace
entries.summary: Challenge the Queen of Sun and Moon beneath the eclipse.
entries.rules: Planned: the boss alternates between Light and Dark forms, changing its defenses and attacks.

entries.title: Endless Tower
entries.summary: Climb higher, conquer challenges, and earn floor rewards.
entries.rules: Planned: 100 floors, potentially expanding to 500. Elites every 5 floors, bosses every 10; first-clear rewards per floor and new rules every 10 floors.
